entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Old Forest and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索古老森林，查明那里潜伏着什么，以及能获得什么宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Maze and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索迷宫，查明那里潜伏着什么，以及能获得什么宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Sandworm Lair and vanquished their Queen.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了沙虫巢穴并杀死了沙虫女皇。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge ice dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了盘踞在那里的巨型冰龙。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Daikara and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索岱卡拉，查明那里潜伏着什么，以及能获得什么宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: Krogar told you to go to the west and look for the Kruk Pride.
entries.target: 克罗加尔告诉你去西面寻找克鲁克部落。

entries.source: After passing through some kind of time anomaly you met a temporal warden who told you to destroy the abominations of this alternate timeline.
entries.target: 穿过某种时间异常后，你碰到了一个时空守卫，他告诉你去摧毁另一条时间线里的怪物。

entries.source: This way leads to the lair of a mighty troll. Traces of blood are everywhere. Are you sure?
entries.target: 这条路通往一头强大巨魔的巢穴，到处都是血迹，你确定要进去吗？

entries.source: There and back again
entries.target: 穿越回来

entries.source: Zemekkys in the Gates of Morning can build a portal back to your homeland for you.
entries.target: 晨曦之门的泽梅基斯可以为你建造一座返回故乡的传送门。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have found a Blood-Runed Athame.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你找到了血符仪式匕首。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* Find a Blood-Runed Athame.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 寻找血符仪式匕首。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have found the Resonating Diamond.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你找到了共鸣钻石。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* Find a Resonating Diamond.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 寻找共鸣钻石。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The portal is now functional and can be used to go back, although, like all portals, it is one-way only.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 传送门现已启用，可以用它返回；不过和所有传送门一样，它只能单向通行。#WHITE#

entries.source: Zemekkys points to the location of Vor Armoury on your map.
entries.target: 泽梅基斯在你的地图上指出了沃尔军械库的位置。

entries.source: Zemekkys points to the location of Briagh's lair on your map.
entries.target: 泽梅基斯在你的地图上指出了布莱亚的巢穴的位置。

entries.source: #VIOLET#Zemekkys starts to draw runes on the floor using the athame and gem dust.
entries.target: #VIOLET#泽梅基斯开始用仪式匕首和宝石粉末在地板上绘制符文。

entries.source: #VIOLET#The whole area starts to shake!
entries.target: #VIOLET#整个区域开始颤抖起来！

entries.source: #VIOLET#Zemekkys says: 'The portal is done!'
entries.target: #VIOLET#泽梅基斯说道：“传送门已经开启！”

entries.source: High Chronomancer Zemekkys
entries.target: 高阶时空法师泽梅基斯

entries.source: The wild wild east
entries.target: 遥远的东方

entries.source: There must be a way to go into the far east from the lair of Golbug. Find it and explore the unknown far east, looking for clues.
entries.target: 在高尔布格的巢穴内肯定有一条通往远东大陆的路。找到它，然后探索那片未知的远东大陆，寻找线索。

entries.source: Air
entries.target: 空气量

entries.source: Air capacity in your lungs. Entities that need not breathe are not affected.
entries.target: 你肺部的空气量。不需要呼吸的生物不受其影响。

entries.source: Stamina
entries.target: 体力值

entries.source: Stamina represents your physical fatigue.  Most physical abilities consume it.
entries.target: 体力值代表你身体的疲劳程度。大部分物理技能都会消耗体力值。

entries.source: Mana
entries.target: 法力值

entries.source: Mana represents your reserve of magical energies. Most spells cast consume mana and each sustained spell reduces your maximum mana.
entries.target: 法力值代表你存储的魔法能量。大部分法术都要消耗法力值，持续法术技能会降低你的最大法力值。

entries.source: Equilibrium
entries.target: 失衡值

entries.source: Equilibrium represents your standing in the grand balance of nature. The closer it is to 0 the more balanced you are. Being out of equilibrium will adversely affect your ability to use Wild Gifts.
entries.target: 失衡值代表你在自然宏大平衡中的位置。失衡值越接近 0，你就越平衡；失衡会对你使用自然系技能的能力产生不利影响。

entries.source: %d (%d%%%% fail)
%d(fail: %s)
entries.target: %d(失败率：%s)

entries.source: Vim
entries.target: 活力值

entries.source: Vim represents the amount of life energy/souls you have stolen. Each corruption talent requires some.
entries.target: 活力值代表你窃取的生命能量/灵魂。堕落系技能需要活力值。

entries.source: Positive energy
entries.target: 正能量

entries.source: Positive energy represents your reserve of positive power. It slowly increases.
entries.target: 正能量代表你存储的太阳力量。它会缓慢增加。

entries.source: Negative energy
entries.target: 负能量

entries.source: Negative energy represents your reserve of negative power. It slowly increases.
entries.target: 负能量代表你存储的星空力量。它会缓慢增加。

entries.source: Hate
entries.target: 仇恨值

entries.source: Hate represents your soul's primal antipathy towards others.  It generally decreases whenever you have no outlet for your rage, and increases when you are damaged or destroy others.
entries.target: 仇恨值代表你灵魂中对他人的原始憎恶。当你无处发泄怒火时，它通常会下降；当你受到伤害或杀死他人时，它会增加。

entries.source: Paradox
entries.target: 紊乱值

entries.source: Paradox represents how much damage you've done to the space-time continuum. A high Paradox score makes Chronomancy less reliable and more dangerous to use but also amplifies its effects.
entries.target: 紊乱值代表你对时空连续性造成的损害。较高的紊乱值会使时空法术变得更难控制，更加危险，但也会提升时空法术的效果。

entries.source: %d/%d(anom: %s)
entries.target: %d/%d(异常：%s)

entries.source: Psi
entries.target: 灵能值

entries.source: Psi represents your reserve of psychic energy.
entries.target: 灵能值代表你存储的精神力量。

entries.source: Souls
entries.target: 灵魂

entries.source: This is the number of soul fragments you have extracted from your foes for your own use.
entries.target: 这是你从敌人身上抽取、留供己用的灵魂碎片数量。

entries.source: #GOLD#PLACED GREATER VAULT: %s
entries.target: #GOLD#放置大型宝库：%s

entries.source: #GOLD#PLACED LESSER VAULT: %s
entries.target: #GOLD#放置小型宝库：%s

entries.source: Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle protects you from silence effects while you remain in its radius while silencing and dealing %d light damage to everyone else who enters. The circle lasts %d turns.
entries.target: 在你的脚下制造一个 %d 格半径范围的法阵，当你在法阵内，它会使你免疫沉默效果，并沉默进入此范围的其他所有生物，对其造成 %d 光系伤害。法阵持续 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle slows incoming projectiles by %d%% and attempts to push all creatures other than yourself out of its radius, inflicting %0.2f light damage and %0.2f darkness damage per turn as it does so.  The circle lasts %d turns.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在你的脚下制造一个 %d 格半径范围的法阵，它会减慢 %d%% 抛射物速度并尝试将除你以外的其他生物推出法阵范围，同时每回合造成 %0.2f 光系伤害和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。法阵持续 %d 回合。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Fade into the darkness and reappear elsewhere within range %d.  When you emerge from the shadows, you are accompanied by a bright flash, dealing %0.2f light damage to enemies in radius 1.
						 The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
匿迹于黑暗之中并在距离 %d 格范围内的另一处重现。一道闪光会伴随着你从阴影中现身，对半径1格范围内的敌人造成 %0.2f 光系伤害。
						 伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
When one of your spells goes critical, you bind glyphs in radius 1 centered on a random target in range %d at the cost of 5 positive and 5 negative energy.
		Glyphs last for %d turns and cause various effects when an enemy enters their grid.
		Glyphs will only spawn on enemies that aren't adjacent to an existing glyph.
		This can only happen every %d game turns.
		Glyph effects will scale with your Spellpower.

		Available glyphs are:
		#ffd700#Glyph of Sunlight#LAST#:  Bind sunlight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a brilliant light, dealing %0.2f light damage and healing you for %d.
		#7f7f7f#Glyph of Moonlight#LAST#:  Bind moonlight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a fatiguing darkness,  dealing %0.2f darkness damage and reducing the foes damage dealt by %d%% for %d turns.
		#9D9DC9#Glyph of Twilight#LAST#:  Bind twilight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a burst of twilight, dealing %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage and knocking the foe back %d tiles.
entries.target:
每当你的法术暴击时，你消耗 5 点正能量和负能量，在范围 %d 内的随机目标周围 1 格半径的区域内放置随机圣印。
		圣印持续 %d 回合，当敌人踩上时，会对其产生特殊效果。
		圣印只会在不与已有圣印相邻的敌人处产生。
		每 %d 游戏回合最多触发一次该效果。
		圣印效果受法术强度加成。

		有以下几种可用的圣印：
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#——将阳光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出明亮耀眼的光芒，造成 %0.2f 光系伤害，并恢复你 %d 生命值。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#——将月光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出疲惫困倦的黑暗，造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并使目标所造成的伤害减少 %d%%， 持续 %d 回合。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#——将暮光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出突然爆炸的暮光，造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并将目标击退 %d 格。

entries.source:
Hits the target with your weapon doing %d%% damage, and with a shield strike doing %d%% damage. If the shield strike connects, your shield will explode in a burst of light that inflicts %0.2f light damage on all targets except yourself within radius %d of the target, and light up all tiles in that radius.
		The light damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
用你的武器对目标造成 %d%% 伤害，同时盾击目标造成 %d%% 伤害。如果盾牌击中目标，则会产生光系爆炸，对范围内除你以外的所有目标造成 %0.2f 光系范围伤害（以目标为中心，半径 %d 格）并照亮受影响区域。
		光系伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Retribution negates half of all damage you take while it is active. Once Retribution has negated %0.2f damage, your shield will explode in a burst of light, inflicting damage equal to the amount negated in a radius of %d and deactivating the talent.
		The amount absorbed will increase with your Spellpower.
		%s
entries.target:
吸收你受到的一半伤害。一旦惩戒之盾吸收 %0.2f 伤害值，它会产生光系爆炸，在 %d 格半径范围内造成等同吸收值的伤害并中断技能效果。
		伤害吸收值受法术强度加成。
		%s

entries.source:
Chant the glory of the Moons, conjuring a shroud of dancing shadows that follows you as long as this spell is active.
		Each turn, a shadowy beam will hit up to %d of your foes within radius 5 for 1 to %0.2f damage.
		This powerful spell will drain %0.1f negative energy for each beam; no beam will fire if your negative energy is too low.
		You may only have one Hymn active at once.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
赞颂月之荣耀，召唤一层舞动的暗影帷幕，在技能激活期间跟随你。
		每回合，暗影射线会击中半径 5 格内至多 %d 个敌人，造成 1 到 %0.2f 点伤害。
		这个强大法术的每道射线消耗 %0.1f 点负能量；负能量过低时不会发射射线。
		同时只能激活一种圣诗。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source:
A magical zone of Sunlight appears around you, healing and shielding all within a radius of %d for %0.2f per turn and increasing healing effects on everyone within by %d%%. The effect lasts for %d turns.
		Existing damage shields will be added to instead of overwritten and have their duration set to 2 if it isn't higher.
		If the same shield is refreshed 20 times it will become unstable and explode, removing it.
		It also lights up the affected area.
		The amount healed will increase with the Magic stat
entries.target:
阳光倾泻在你周围 %d 格范围内，每回合治疗所有单位 %0.2f 生命值，给予其等量的护盾，并增加此范围内所有人 %d%% 治疗效果。此效果持续 %d 回合。
		如果已经存在护盾，则护盾将会增加等量数值，如果护盾持续时间不足 2 回合，会延长至 2 回合。
		当同一个护盾被刷新 20 次后，将会因为不稳定而破碎。
		它同时会照亮此区域。
		治疗量受魔力值加成。

entries.source:
Fire a glowing orb of light at each enemy within your Radiance.  Each orb will slowly follow its target until it connects, dealing %d light damage to anything else it contacts along the way.  When the target is reached the orb will explode dealing %d light damage in radius 1 and healing you for 50%% of the damage dealt.
		All targets struck by your Judgement will be blighted by light, reducing saves by %d, reducing critical power by %d%%, and causing light damage received to splash in radius 2 for %d%% damage against all hostile targets for 4 turns.
entries.target:
在你的光辉中，向每一个敌人发射一个发光的球体。球体会缓慢追踪目标，直到击中目标，对它沿途接触到的其他物体造成 %d 点光系伤害。当到达目标时，球体将爆炸，在半径 1 格范围内造成 %d 点光系伤害，并治疗你 50%% 伤害量的生命值。
		所有被裁决击中的目标都会受到光之枯萎：全豁免降低 %d， 暴击伤害加成降低 %d%%； 其受到的光系伤害会以 %d%% 的伤害溅射至半径 2 内的所有敌对目标，持续 4 回合。

entries.source:
Invokes a blast of shadows that deals %0.2f darkness damage, and leaves a radius 3 field that does %0.2f darkness damage per turn for %d turns.
		The damage dealt will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
引起一片暗影爆炸，对目标造成 %0.2f 点暗影伤害，并在 3 格半径范围的区域内每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
A surge of twilight pulses from you, doing %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage to all others within radius %d.
		The damage dealt will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
一股汹涌的光暗狂潮从你身上迸发，对半径 %d 格内除你之外的所有生物造成 %0.2f 点光系和 %0.2f 点暗影伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
A star falls on a radius %d area, doing %0.2f darkness damage on impact and stunning all within the area for 4 turns.
		The damage dealt will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你摇落星辰，震慑 %d 格半径范围内所有目标 4 回合，并造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Invokes the Sun to cause a flare within radius %d, blinding your foes for %d turns and lighting up the area.
		All enemies effected will take %0.2f light damage.
		At talent level 3 you gain %d%% light, darkness, and fire resistance for %d turns.
		The damage done and resistances will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
祈祷太阳之力，在 %d 格半径范围内致盲目标，持续 %d 回合并照亮你的周围区域。
		范围内的敌人将会受到 %0.2f 光系伤害。
		等级 3 时，你将获得 %d%% 光系、暗影和火焰伤害抗性，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害和抗性受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Create a shadow jumpgate at your current location. As long as you sustain this spell, you can use 'Jumpgate: Teleport' to instantly travel to the jumpgate, as long as you are within %d tiles of it.
		Note that any stairs underneath the jumpgate will be unusable while the spell is sustained, and you may need to cancel this sustain in order to leave certain locations.
		At talent level 4, you learn to create and sustain a second jumpgate.
entries.target:
在你的位置制造 1 个阴影跃迁之门，当你激活这个技能时你可以使用“跃迁之门：传送”技能立即传送至此（跃迁之门必须在你 %d 格范围以内）。
		注意：当此技能激活且楼梯位于跃迁之门下方时，楼梯将不可使用。在某些区域，你可能需要取消此技能才能离开。
		在等级 4 时，你可以制造 2 个跃迁之门。

entries.source:
Let out a mental cry that shatters the will of your targets within radius %d, dealing %0.2f darkness damage and confusing (%d%% to act randomly) them for %d turns.
		The damage will improve with your spellpower and the duration will improve with your Cunning.
entries.target:
在 %d 格半径范围内释放一股精神冲击，摧毁目标的意志，对其造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并使其混乱 (%d%% 几率随机行动)，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成，持续时间受灵巧加成。

entries.source: Create a second shadow jumpgate at your location. As long as you sustain this spell, you can use 'Jumpgate: Teleport' to instantly travel to the jumpgate, as long as you are within %d tiles of it.
entries.target: 在你当前位置创造第二个暗影跃迁之门。只要你维持本法术，便可使用「跃迁之门II：传送」立即传送至该跃迁之门，只要你在其 %d 格范围内。

entries.source: Instantly travel to your second jumpgate, as long as you are within %d tiles of it.
entries.target: 立即将你传送至先前创造的第 2 个跃迁之门，距离不超过 %d 格。

entries.source:
Sends out a blast wave of gravity in a radius %d cone, dealing %0.2f base physical (gravity) damage and knocking back targets caught in the area.
		Targets knocked into walls or other targets take 25%% additional damage and deal 25%% damage to targets they're knocked into.
		Closer targets will be knocked back further and the damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在半径 %d 格的锥形范围内释放一股爆炸性的重力冲击波，造成 %0.2f 物理（重力）伤害并击退范围内目标。
		被击飞至墙上或其他单位的目标受到额外 25%% 伤害，并对被击中的单位造成 25%% 伤害。
		离你越近的目标将会被击飞得更远。受法术强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

entries.source:
Fires a beam that turns matter into dust, inflicting %0.2f temporal damage and %0.2f physical (warp) damage.
		Alternatively you may target yourself, creating a field of radius %d around you that will inflict the damage over three turns.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
发射一道射线，令物质归于尘土，造成 %0.2f 时空伤害与 %0.2f 物理（扭曲）伤害。
		也可以以自己为目标，制造一个围绕自己 %d 格的领域，在 3 回合内造成伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
You surround yourself with a radius %d distortion of gravity, knocking back and dealing %0.2f physical damage to all creatures inside it.  The effect lasts %d turns.  Deals 50%% extra damage to pinned targets, in addition to the knockback.
		The blast wave may hit targets more then once, depending on the radius and the knockback effect.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你用 %d 格半径范围的重力扭曲场围绕自己，击退所有单位并造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。此效果持续 %d 回合。除击退效果外，还对定身状态的目标额外造成 50%% 伤害。
		这股爆炸性冲击波可能会对目标造成多次伤害，这取决于攻击半径和击退效果。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
You manipulate the spacetime continuum in such a way that you switch places with another creature with in a range of %d.  The targeted creature will be confused (power %d%%) for %d turns.
		The spell's hit chance will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你操纵时空连续体，与 %d 格范围内的另一个生物交换位置。目标会混乱 （%d%% 强度） %d 回合。
		法术命中率受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Destabilizes the target, inflicting %0.2f temporal damage per turn for 10 turns.  If the target dies while destabilized, it will explode, doing %0.2f temporal damage and %0.2f physical damage in a radius of 4.
		If the target dies while also under the effects of continuum destabilization, all explosion damage will be done as temporal damage.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
使目标所处的时空出现裂隙，每回合造成 %0.2f 时空伤害，持续 10 回合。如果目标在此效果持续期间死亡，则会产生 4 格半径范围的时空爆炸，造成 %0.2f 时空伤害和 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		如果目标死亡时处于连续体失稳状态，则爆炸产生的所有伤害会转化为时空伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Randomly teleports all enemies within a radius of three.  Enemies will be teleported between %d and %d tiles from you and may be stunned, blinded, confused, or pinned for %d turns.
		The chance of teleportion will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
将半径 3 以内的敌人随机传送。
		敌人将会传送至距离你 %d 至 %d 格的范围内，并可能被震慑、致盲、混乱或定身 %d 回合。
		传送几率与法术强度相关。

entries.source:
You fold the space between yourself and a second point within a range of %d, creating a pair of wormholes.  Any creature stepping on either wormhole will be teleported near the other (radius %d accuracy).  
		The wormholes will last %d turns and must be placed at least two tiles apart.
		The chance of teleporting enemies will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你创造一对虫洞，使你所在之处和 %d 格范围内一点的空间重叠。  任何踏入虫洞的生物会被传送至另一个虫洞附近 (精度半径 %d)。
		虫洞持续 %d 回合并且至少相距两格。
		传送敌人的几率受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
When you teleport you fire a pulse that jolts enemies out of phase in a radius of %d around both the start and the destination point. 
		Each target has a %d%% chance per tile you travelled to be stunned, blinded, confused, or pinned for %d turns.
entries.target:
每当你进行传送，你发射一道脉冲将起点和终点半径 %d 格内的敌人击出位面。
		你每传送一格，被击中的目标将有 %d%% 的几率被震慑、致盲、混乱或者定身 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Inflicts %0.2f temporal damage, and attempts to stun all targets in a radius %d ball for %d turns.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
造成 %0.2f 时空伤害，并试图震慑半径 %d 格范围内所有目标 %d 回合。
		受法术强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

entries.source:
Project a corrupted blast of power that removes up to %d magical or physical effects or any type of sustain and deals %0.2f blight damage to any creatures caught in the radius 3 ball.
		For each effect, the creature has a chance to resist based on its spell save.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在 3 格球形范围内制造一个堕落能量球，移除范围内任意怪物至多 %d 种魔法/物理效果或任意类型的持续技能，并造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		每次尝试除去一个效果时，基于法术豁免，目标都有一定概率抵抗。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Infects the target with a corrosive worm for 6 turns that reduces blight and acid resistance by %d%% and feeds off damage taken.
		When this effect ends or the target dies the worm will explode, dealing %d acid damage in a 4 radius ball. This damage will increase by %d%% of all damage taken while infected.
		The damage dealt by the effect will increase with spellpower.
entries.target:
用腐蚀蠕虫感染目标 6 回合，降低目标 %d%% 枯萎和酸性抗性，蠕虫会以目标受到的伤害为食。
		效果结束或者目标死亡时，蠕虫会爆炸，在 4 格半径内造成 %d 酸性伤害。同时，感染期内目标受到的伤害会按 %d%% 的比例计入爆炸伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
You extract corrupted blood from your own body, hitting everything in a frontal cone of radius %d for %0.2f blight damage.
		Each creature hit has a %d%% chance of being infected by a random disease, doing %0.2f blight damage and weakening either Constitution, Strength or Dexterity for 6 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你从自身射出堕落之血，对前方 %d 格半径锥形范围内的所有单位造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		每个受影响的单位有 %d%% 概率感染 1 种随机疾病，受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，并且随机弱化目标体质、力量和敏捷中的一项属性，持续 6 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
